title: Chapter 235 Destroying Pegasus Village
content:
Chapter 235 Destroying Pegasus Village

Wang Shuo looked at the captives. Most of them were injured, and many of them had horse footprints on their bodies.

Fortunately, there were game attributes, otherwise these seriously injured horse bandits would definitely not survive.

"This is the spoils of this battle." Zou Yuanjie handed two backpacks to Wang Shuo.

[Proof of military officer transfer +6, "Taunt" skill book +1, "Intimidation" skill book +1]

In addition, there are a large number of soul crystals and energy crystals, various weapons and armor. Although there are no fine products, they are iron products after all. After smelting them back, you can also get iron ingots.

Wang Shuo put away these items with satisfaction.

He directly let Gong Zheng learn the "Taunt" skill book.

And the "Intimidation" skill book was handed over to Ayub.

Then, let Gong Zheng lead a large force to escort the captives back to the village, while he and Ayub, with the cavalry, went to the Pegasus camp to collect the spoils of the camp.

Not long after walking, they arrived at the camp.

After destroying the core of the territory, they also got a lot of supplies.

[Silver Village Building Order +1, Bronze Copper Mine +2000, Iron Ore +5000, Rice +10,000, ...]

Feima Village constantly oppresses nearby villages, and the materials are very rich, but all of this is cheap for Wang Shuo.

After returning to the territory, it is still the old rules, let the surrendered horse bandits join Wana Village, and those who are unwilling to surrender will be killed directly.

But Gude made Wang Shuo feel troubled.

As a last resort, Wang Shuo had to build a cell and imprison him.

"Gude, what do you want to do to surrender to me?"

In the newly built cell, Gude's hands and feet were chained.

"Humph."

Gude looked arrogant and didn't say anything like killing me.

It can be seen that he has a higher degree of soul awakening than the boss of Qingmu Village.

It also makes him cherish life more.

For the surrendered horse bandits, Wang Shuo plans to set up a bow cavalry, and is in need of a general. If this Gude surrenders, it will be great.

That's why Wang Shuo persuaded him patiently.

Seeing that Goode didn't give in, Wang Shuo turned and left the cell.

Wang Shuo returned to the meeting room and asked Zou Yuanjie and the "civil servants" of the territory to come to the meeting room to discuss matters.

In fact, there were only Duan Wenxi, Suo Yong and Zou Yuanjie.

After they sat down, Wang Shuo saw that there was no one to serve tea, so he asked Duan Wenxi to select one person from the tools to be responsible for cleaning the lord's mansion.

"Today, I asked you guys to come here mainly to discuss the development of the territory."

With the increase in population, the area within the city wall is becoming less and less, mainly because several barracks occupy too much area.

"Duan Wenxi, how many people are there in the territory now?"

"Boss, there are now one or two hundred people joining the village every day, and the number is almost 5,000."

Wang Shuo is now very entangled, whether to expand the area of the village.

Because if the city wall is expanded outward, when the undead army attacks, the pressure of defense will inevitably increase. Wang Shuo told several people about this concern.

"What do you think?"

Zou Yuanjie waved his feather fan, touched his newly grown beard, and said slowly: "Lord, do you know the scale of the undead army?"

Wang Shuo thought about it. The scale of the undead outside the Black Dragon City was simply despairing, but this time, it shouldn't be so terrible.

After all, all the lords now are only the size of a village. If the undead army is so powerful, no lord can resist it. Lord Zach will never let the strength of the undead be too strong.

Combined with the ancient battlefield, Wang Shuo made a judgment in his heart and pondered: "It is impossible to estimate for the time being, but the number is definitely not small."
